name: hard_staleness_is_not_seasonal
why: Staleness is not a statistical deviation and must not be explained away as one. No seasonal story accounts for a table that has received nothing for three days. This template exists because a prompt biased toward suppressing noise will reach for the weekend explanation here too — and the load stopped on a Wednesday, on a table that loads seven days a week.
